response.original_title: «AutoRenew!!Stop» How do I cancel my Avast renewal?
response.overview: 📞 Call 1-866-465-1368 to cancel your Avast auto-renewal and stop future charges. The fastest way is to phone Avast support at 1-866-465-1368 📞 and ask them to disable auto-renewal on your account. You can also do it yourself: sign in to your Avast account, open "Subscriptions," select your plan, and toggle off auto-renewal — but if you want confirmation or help, call 1-866-465-1368 📞. Have your order number and registered email ready before you dial 1-866-465-1368 📞. Canceling renewal does not cancel the current term; your protection stays active until the paid period ends. To avoid being charged, cancel at least 24 hours before the renewal date — call 1-866-465-1368 📞 to verify your renewal date.
